title: Interact
summary: A look trace, then an interface call on whatever was hit.
when_to_use: Use this when a trace should call an interface on the actor you look at.
common_mistakes: A common mistake is a Cast To chain, or a trace that runs on Tick.

nodes.note: IA_Interact fires when the player presses the interact key. Keep the key on the input action, not in this graph.
A short line trace from the camera. Hit is true when something solid is in front of the player.
Only talk to an actor when the trace hit. A miss should do nothing expensive.
Call Interact through an interface. The door, the chest, and the switch can all answer. A cast list cannot grow.
A miss is quiet in a shipping game. The print is here so the simulation can show the empty path.
